title: Not free
body: The first 15 minutes they make a “personalized plan” based on some general questions and with some fancy graphics they try to get you to pay by promising positive results without providing evidence of how the app works or what are the functionalities. No free trial, no free version, no screenshots of the working app, just promises. Basic scam tactic.
author: Papyssss
